Noah's Ark, Genesis 6 to 9. Long ago, people were doing bad things, and God was grieved, but Noah walked with God. God said, Build a big boat, an ark. Noah obeyed. Animals came two by two, and Noah's family came in. It rained forty days, but God kept them safe. When the flood was over, God put a bow in the sky, a promise that He would never again destroy the world with a flood. God keeps His Word. You can trust Him when obeying costs time or courage.
